RaggieSoft Studio • Upcoming Desktop Hub & Static-CDN Updater IDE

RaggieSoft Launcher Studio — Build Your Own Branded Desktop Hub.

Independent software studios, game/utility creators, authors, musicians, and enterprise internal-tools teams often maintain multiple desktop applications and downloadable media archives—yet building a polished, accessible desktop hub and delta patcher from scratch takes months. Inspired directly by our production RaggieSoft Launcher, RaggieSoft Launcher Studio turns that zero-account, static-CDN architecture into a visual IDE and plain-text .rslp compiler for everyone.

LauncherStudio.exe • White-Label Desktop Hub & Static-CDN Updater IDE

LauncherStudio.exe — Branded Desktop App Hub & Catalog Compiler

Publish a static signed catalog.json alongside your .msi, .msp, or Engine = native packages on any HTTPS server, S3 bucket, or Cloudflare R2 bucket—zero database servers to maintain, zero forced customer logins, and mandatory SHA-256 + WinVerifyTrust signature verification before any update executes.
Zero Gatekeepers • Zero Forced Logins • Zero Database Servers

Core Architectural Pillars of Launcher Studio

1. Static-CDN Catalog Publishing (catalog.json)

Host your entire update channel on any static HTTPS web server, DigitalOcean Spaces bucket, Amazon S3 bucket, or Cloudflare R2 bucket. lncbuild.exe compiles your .rslp project into a deterministic, signed catalog.json manifest—requiring zero backend SQL databases, zero Docker containers, and zero recurring server maintenance.

2. Multi-Content Shelves: Apps, Books & Audio

First-class support for both transactional Windows Installer applications (.msi / .msp built with Installer Studio) and multi-gigabyte Engine = native offline content packs (illustrated eBooks, lossless/streaming audio albums, sample packs, and documentation sets).

3. Mandatory SHA-256 & WinVerifyTrust Security

Every catalog item stamps exact byte sizes and SHA-256 digests at build time. Before launching any downloaded installer or applying a patch, the client verifies both the cryptographic hash via Windows bcrypt.dll and the publisher’s Authenticode signature via WinVerifyTrust.

4. WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast & Full Keyboard / Gamepad Nav

Customize Light Mode, Dark Mode, and brand accent tokens with the same live W3C luminance enforcer shipped in Installer Studio v0.5.0—guaranteeing ≥ 4.5:1 button contrast, clean Tab and arrow-key shelf navigation, screen-reader download progress announcements, and instant SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST compliance.

Git-Diffable & AI-Agent Friendly

Draft Plain-Text .rslp Launcher Project Grammar

Just like .rsip in Installer Studio, every visual edit inside LauncherStudio.exe round-trips losslessly to a human-readable INI manifest whose comments survive GUI saves byte-for-byte: 

; Sample .rslp manifest — compiles branded Launcher.exe + static-CDN catalog.json
[Launcher]
Name              = Starlight Creative Hub
Publisher         = Starlight Audio & Interactive
Version           = 1.0.0
UpgradeCode       = {4D81C2F0-91A4-4E7B-8C12-7F39A50E21B8}
CatalogUrl        = https://cdn.example-owned-domain/launcher/catalog.json
RequireSignature  = true

[Branding]
WindowStyle       = fluentmica
AccentLight       = #1D4ED8
AccentDark        = #38BDF8
EnforceWcagAA     = true

[Shelf.Apps]
Title             = Desktop Applications
Layout            = cards

[Item.SynthWorkstation]
Shelf             = Apps
PackageEngine     = msi
ProjectRef        = ..installersSynthWorkstation.rsip
ReleaseNotesFile  = .
otessynth-1.4.0.md

[Shelf.CompanionMedia]
Title             = Offline Liner Notes & Soundtracks
Layout            = covers
